result.keywords: AbstractPDBConnect is a fictional service for improving discovery of macromolecular and sequence-linked structural records across curated biology databases. It integrates structure annotations, external molecule mappings, and advanced cross-search tools to help researchers locate, compare, and interpret protein, RNA, and small-molecule entries. The platform emphasizes enhanced visualization, standardized metadata enrichment, and easier access to linked experimental and functional information for the structural biology community.
